name: Fizzer
description: A walking bomb: it wanders, walks up to whoever it sees, lights its wick with a hiss and, if they have not run, goes pop, hurting everyone near and breaking bricks where the game allows brick damage. The shared bot brain decides when; its rules (Fizzer Rules) decide what the pop is. Its body is also a player type. Part of the Mixed Add-On Playground; it knows nothing about any other Add-On.
